requirements.title: Pointer association permits target reference and exact target mutation through the pointer
requirements.definition: Pointer association between a pointer and a target allows the target to be referenced by a reference to the pointer.

pending.pointer-reference-reads-target: integer, target :: t=42; pointer p=>t; observed initialized -777 is assigned p and must be exact 42.
pending.pointer-reference-defines-target: integer, target :: t=1; pointer p=>t; assigning p=42 changes t to exact 42, proving the pointer reference denotes the target.

requirements.title: Pointers can be associated, disassociated, undefined, or associated with different own-image targets over time
requirements.definition: During execution a pointer may be undefined, associated with different targets on its own image, or disassociated.

pending.associated-status-over-time: Start with NULL pointer p and targets a=1,b=2; assign p=>a then p=>b and observe ASSOCIATED(p,a) true then ASSOCIATED(p,b) true plus exact p values 1 then 2.
pending.disassociated-status-over-time: Associate p=>a first, then NULLIFY(p); ASSOCIATED(p) must be false after a prior true state.
pending.undefined-status-no-oracle: No portable runtime oracle inspects undefined pointer association status; the source plan records event paths only and reestablishes defined status before any inquiry.
pending.different-own-image-targets: Single-image plan uses two distinct target variables a=1 and b=2 on the same image, pointer-assigns p to each in turn, and observes exact values 1 then 2.

requirements.title: Associated data pointers share definition status, deferred parameters or shape, and polymorphic dynamic type with their target
requirements.definition: The definition status of an associated data pointer is that of its target. Deferred type parameters or shape are assumed from the target, and a polymorphic pointer assumes the dynamic type of the target.

pending.associated-pointer-definition-status-is-: Target integer t is initialized to 42 before p=>t; reading p into observed=-777 gives exact 42, and assigning p=77 changes t to 77.
pending.deferred-shape-from-target: Rank-one target a(2:4)=[10,20,30] and pointer p(:)=>a; LBOUND(p)=2, UBOUND(p)=4, and p(3)=20 are exact after association.
pending.deferred-type-parameters-from-target: Character(len=5), target :: s="abcde"; character(:), pointer :: p=>s; LEN(p)=5 and p="abcde" are exact.
pending.polymorphic-pointer-dynamic-type-from-ta: class(base), pointer p=>child_target with component v=42; SELECT TYPE(p) TYPE IS(child) reads exact v=42, proving dynamic type transfer.
